proposed_sites.reason: The mcp.server.fastmcp module path is removed in v2 (moved to mcp.server.mcpserver), and the FastMCP class is renamed to MCPServer. Both the import path and the imported identifier must change to: from mcp.server.mcpserver import MCPServer
Constructs the server using the old class name FastMCP, which no longer exists under that name in v2; must be changed to MCPServer(name="secops-mcp", ...) to match the renamed class imported above
